name: writing
summary: Canonical discipline for evidence-safe written artifacts across website copy, blog/article drafts, editing, social, newsletters, email drafts, review narratives, and content strategy.
blocking_rules: Do not publish, send, schedule, or externally mutate written content without explicit approval.
Do not present unsupported factual claims as verified.
Do not use missing Brand or Voice context silently for client-specific work.
Do not let a producer close its own quality gate.
